items.name: The Savoy
items.description: London's most iconic luxury hotel on the Thames. Art Deco interiors, Michelin-starred dining and impeccable service since 1889.

items.name: Claridge's
items.description: The definitive London luxury hotel in the heart of Mayfair. Art Deco masterpiece with world-famous afternoon tea and celebrity clientele.

items.name: Shangri-La The Shard
items.description: Stunning hotel occupying floors 34-52 of The Shard with the highest infinity pool in London and breathtaking 360° views.

items.name: The Ned
items.description: Spectacular hotel in a restored 1924 bank building with 9 restaurants, rooftop pool and members club. One of London's most exciting hotel openings.

items.name: Corinthia London
items.description: One of Europe's finest hotels with London's largest hotel spa. Stunning Victorian architecture near Trafalgar Square.

items.name: citizenM Tower of London
items.description: Smart budget hotel with incredible Tower of London views. Stylish rooms, 24/7 food and brilliant location for sightseeing.

items.name: Hub by Premier Inn Kings Cross
items.description: Smart compact rooms at great value near Kings Cross. Perfect base for exploring London with easy tube access to all attractions.

items.name: Great Northern Hotel
items.description: Beautifully restored Victorian railway hotel with boutique rooms, excellent dining and unbeatable location at Kings Cross.

items.name: Sofitel London Heathrow
items.description: Luxury hotel directly connected to Terminal 5. Perfect for early flights or late arrivals. French-inspired elegance with excellent dining.

items.name: London Hilton on Park Lane
items.description: Family-friendly luxury hotel with spectacular Hyde Park views. Kids stay and eat free. Excellent facilities for all ages.

items.name: Bulgari Hotel London
items.description: Ultra-luxury Italian hotel with London's most indulgent spa — 1000sqm of treatments, pool and relaxation. The definition of pampering.

items.name: Four Seasons Park Lane
items.description: London's finest spa hotel with panoramic Hyde Park views. Award-winning spa, Michelin-starred dining and legendary Four Seasons service.

items.name: Travelodge London Central
items.description: Reliable budget accommodation across multiple central London locations. Clean, simple rooms in great locations — perfect for those on a tight budget.

items.name: Kimpton Fitzroy London
items.description: Stunning Victorian hotel on Russell Square with a glamorous all-day brasserie, rooftop views and excellent central location near the British Museum.

items.name: London Marriott Hotel County Hall
items.description: Family-friendly hotel inside the historic County Hall beside the Thames. Steps from the London Eye, Aquarium and South Bank attractions.

items.name: YOTEL London Clerkenwell
items.description: Smart tech-forward budget hotel with clever compact cabins. Great for solo travellers — automated check-in, robotic luggage storage and coworking spaces.

items.name: The Langham London
items.description: Europe's first grand hotel, opposite the BBC and Oxford Circus. Timeless elegance, legendary Palm Court afternoon tea and a stunning spa.

items.name: The Ritz London
items.description: The definition of London glamour on Piccadilly. Louis XVI-style decor, legendary afternoon tea in the Palm Court, and a dress code that matches the grandeur.

items.name: The Dorchester
items.description: Legendary Park Lane hotel overlooking Hyde Park. Home to the Michelin-starred Alain Ducasse restaurant and one of London's most iconic bars.

items.name: Brown's Hotel
items.description: London's oldest hotel, established 1837. Elegant Mayfair townhouse hotel with a Michelin-starred restaurant and famous English afternoon tea.

items.name: The Connaught
items.description: Discreet luxury in the heart of Mayfair. Home to the Connaught Bar — one of the world's best bars — and an exceptional Aman spa.

items.name: The Soho Hotel
items.description: Chic boutique hotel in the heart of Soho, popular with the film and fashion crowd. Stylish rooms and a lively screening room bar.

items.name: Covent Garden Hotel
items.description: Elegant Firmdale hotel right in Covent Garden. English country house style meets central London convenience — perfect for theatre trips.

items.name: The Z Hotel Soho
items.description: Compact, stylish and unbeatable location right in Soho. Small rooms but huge value for the postcode — perfect for exploring on foot.

items.name: Ham Yard Hotel
items.description: Firmdale boutique hotel with a private garden, bowling alley and rooftop terrace — a hidden oasis right in Soho.

items.name: The Trafalgar St. James
items.description: Stylish hotel overlooking Trafalgar Square with a rooftop bar offering unbeatable views over Nelson's Column and Big Ben.

items.name: The Bloomsbury Hotel
items.description: Elegant family-friendly hotel near the British Museum with spacious rooms, kids activity packs and a great central location for family sightseeing.

items.name: Novotel London Waterloo
items.description: Spacious family rooms with bunk beds available, kids eat free, and a great location near the London Eye and South Bank attractions.

items.name: Mandarin Oriental Hyde Park
items.description: World-renowned spa hotel overlooking Hyde Park with an award-winning spa offering signature Oriental treatments and a stunning pool.

items.name: ESPA Life at Corinthia
items.description: London's largest hotel spa spread across four floors, with a thermal suite, hydrotherapy pool and extensive treatment menu.

items.name: The Hoxton, Shoreditch
items.description: The original 'open house' hotel where the lobby doubles as a vibrant local hangout — design-led rooms in the heart of East London's creative scene.

items.name: Sun Street Hotel
items.description: Georgian architecture meets modern industrial-chic interiors — great value boutique stay near Liverpool Street and Shoreditch.

items.name: Artist Residence London
items.description: A tiny 10-room townhouse hidden in Pimlico — each room uniquely decorated with upcycled art and vintage finds, easy walk to Buckingham Palace.

items.name: The Pilgrm
items.description: Stylish budget boutique hotel across several historic buildings opposite Paddington station — 73 rooms ranging from tiny Nooks to Snugs.

items.name: Mama Shelter Bethnal Green
items.description: A burst of colour and energy near Broadway Market and London Fields — courtyard bar, king-size beds and private Japanese-style karaoke rooms.

items.name: Bingham Riverhouse
items.description: A serene 15-room boutique hotel on the Thames in leafy Richmond — pastel interiors by Nicola Harding, some rooms with copper bathtubs overlooking the river.

items.name: Leman Locke
items.description: Stylish apart-hotel 900 metres from the Tower of London and Brick Lane — great for longer stays with kitchenette-equipped rooms.

items.name: Ace Hotel London Shoreditch
items.description: A hub for galleries, theatre and fashion crowds — basement bar, gym and 24-hour restaurant in the heart of East London's creative district.

items.name: The Zetter Hotel
items.description: An award-winning quirky boutique hotel in fashionable Clerkenwell — playful design with a rooftop terrace and cosy restaurant.

items.name: The Franklin Hotel
items.description: Elegant Starhotels Collezione property steps from the Victoria and Albert Museum — refined, quiet luxury in the heart of Kensington.

items.name: The Grazing Goat
items.description: A stylish pub-with-rooms in Marylebone — bar, restaurant and comfortable rooms above one of the area's best gastropubs.

items.name: Mandarin Oriental Mayfair
items.description: The luxe Hong Kong brand's second London property — sublime Mayfair address on the most coveted spot on the Monopoly board.

items.name: Sea Containers London
items.description: A design-led hotel right on the Thames with 1930s ocean-liner styling — steps from the London Eye and South Bank's theatre scene.

items.name: Bankside Hotel, Autograph Collection
items.description: A sustainability-focused boutique hotel near Tate Modern and the Globe — locally sourced materials and genuinely striking design.

items.name: Park Plaza Westminster Bridge
items.description: One of the largest hotels near Westminster with river-facing rooms looking straight at Big Ben — reliable comfort in an unbeatable location.

items.name: Premier Inn London County Hall
items.description: Reliable, affordable rooms inside the historic County Hall building — right next to the London Eye and Westminster Bridge.

items.name: Hilton London Canary Wharf
items.description: A stone's throw from Canary Wharf Underground station — smart design, plastic-free water bottles and comfortable rooms for business or leisure.

items.name: Novotel London Canary Wharf
items.description: Towers high above the surrounding buildings with a sophisticated top-floor bar and some of the best views in Canary Wharf.

items.name: Canary Riverside Plaza Hotel
items.description: A tranquil riverside escape amid the vibrant Canary Wharf district — floor-to-ceiling windows with Thames views, calming blue-and-white interiors.

items.name: The Collective Canary Wharf
items.description: Stylish studio rooms with modern kitchenettes plus an on-site spa and wellness centre — great value for the area.

items.name: Roseate House London
items.description: Victorian elegance meets modern amenities — a stone's throw from Hyde Park and Paddington Station, with silk bed details and original oil paintings.

items.name: Royal Lancaster London
items.description: A grand hotel overlooking Hyde Park with panoramic city views from upper floors — spacious rooms and a genuinely central Paddington-adjacent location.

items.name: Hotel Indigo London Paddington
items.description: A boutique IHG hotel with locally-inspired design touches near Paddington Station — modern rooms with a strong sense of neighbourhood character.

items.name: The Clermont London, Victoria
items.description: A distinguished, eco-certified hotel right by Victoria Station — upscale, sustainable and popular with business travellers.

items.name: DoubleTree by Hilton London Angel Kings Cross
items.description: Reliable Hilton comfort in Islington, near Regent's Canal and Little Venice — warm cookie on arrival, well-connected for exploring North London.

items.name: Premier Inn London Angel Islington
items.description: Reliable budget comfort near Upper Street's restaurants and bars — great value base for exploring North London.

items.name: Citadines Islington London
items.description: Serviced apartment-style rooms with kitchenettes near Angel — great for longer stays, families or those who want more space and flexibility.

items.name: The Portobello Hotel
items.description: One of London's most famous boutique hotels — a bohemian bolthole on Portobello Road with legendary rock-star history, quiet and grounded despite the fame.

items.name: Six Senses London
items.description: A full-service spa hotel with 24-hour gym and highly personal service — one of Notting Hill's newest luxury additions.

items.name: The Laslett
items.description: Comfort and style near Notting Hill Coronet and Portobello Road Market — fitness facilities, terrace and a genuinely local neighbourhood feel.

items.name: Chelsea Harbour Hotel & Spa
items.description: Breathtaking marina views blending luxury, culture and comfort — all-suite hotel by the Thames in one of London's most exclusive postcodes.

items.name: The Resident Kensington
items.description: Sleek, self-catering-friendly rooms with a boutique feel — close to the Natural History Museum and South Kensington's museum quarter.

items.name: La Suite West - Hyde Park
items.description: A full-service spa hotel with garden and terrace near Hyde Park — intimate, design-focused rooms with a genuinely relaxing atmosphere.

items.name: The Standard, London
items.description: A converted 1970s brutalist building opposite King's Cross station — bold, colourful interiors and a rooftop restaurant with skyline views.
items.nearestStation: King's Cross St Pancras (2 min walk)

items.name: Wombat's City Hostel London
items.description: A well-reviewed backpacker hostel with dorms and private rooms — free walking tours, on-site bar and a very sociable atmosphere.

items.name: St Christopher's Inn Greenwich
items.description: A lively hostel with its own party bar, popular with young travellers — quieter than central hostels but close to the O2, Cutty Sark and Greenwich Park.

items.name: Novotel London Greenwich
items.description: Reliable comfort near the historic Maritime Greenwich UNESCO World Heritage site — Cutty Sark, Royal Observatory and the Prime Meridian all within walking distance.

items.name: The Marylebone
items.description: A refined boutique hotel in one of London's most elegant neighbourhoods — independent shops, cafes and Regent's Park all on the doorstep.

items.name: Nobu Hotel London Portman Square
items.description: Sleek, design-forward hotel from the Nobu hospitality brand — sophisticated rooms and the acclaimed Nobu restaurant on site.

items.name: Durrants Hotel
items.description: A charming Georgian townhouse hotel dating back to 1790 — classic English character close to Oxford Street and Regent's Park.

items.name: The Mandeville Hotel
items.description: A stylish independent hotel tucked away on a quiet Marylebone street — cocktail bar and comfortable rooms just off Oxford Street.

items.name: InterContinental London - The O2
items.description: A striking waterfront hotel next to The O2 arena — floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Thames, popular for concert-goers and business travellers alike.
